benchmark.note: the direct rule is the object a category allocation implies; the share regression is a best-fit upper bound on it because its coefficients are fitted, while the rule's are the realised category rates

icc_vs_autocorr.note: the published 0.494 was measured after mix only, so it carried common year shocks. Removing year effects separates the two. A within-bank residual autocorrelation materially above zero means the transitory part is itself serially correlated, which is the structure Spearman-Brown does NOT assume
